claim: posToNumber passes the current line's own length (lines[i].length) as the source index to lineTerminatorLengthAt instead of the cumulative offset (start), so for line >= 3 with CRLF input the terminator length is checked at the wrong character and the returned offset is wrong (e.g. posToNumber('a\r\nbb\r\nc', {line:3, column:0}) yields 6 instead of the correct 7), defeating the CRLF fix for any multi-line file beyond the second line.
